body:
> Verify that XML or JSON schema is in place and verified before accepting input.	


I am not sure how many frameworks really support strict XML/JSON schema validation without hassle. Sounds like the sort of thing you would need an API gateway or WAF to do easily. I assume that other controls (e.g. 18.5) would cover the need for validation of the values within the schema so I would consider raising this to L2 or L3.

comments.body: I think this is really basic API security and wish to leave it as L1 to push the envelope. This is REALLY basics security controls and most frameworks integrate it anyhow...

title: 18.4 - XML/JSON schema - really L1?
